selection_rule: Freeze candidates from observable coverage and data quality only. Do not inspect gravity residuals, inferred dark-matter slopes, alternative-gravity parameters, or model preference.

host_inventory_outcome.hard_shortfall_alternative: A reproducible source-by-source ledger showing the search space, every located host, exact public products, and the specific missing observable for each exclusion.
required_fields_per_host: disturbance flag defined without gravity residuals
resolved BCG stellar-kinematic source, bin count, and radial support
BCG light and other baryonic-profile source and uncertainty
strong-lens image positions, source redshifts, and stated positional errors
number of strict image positions inside the dynamics support
lens nuisance model, covariance, or posterior-product availability
stable URL or DOI, local file, checksum, and exclusion reason

cycle_control.cycle_definition: Screen at least 10 previously unaudited BCG hosts or exhaust one named primary-source resolved-BCG sample, whichever occurs first.
cycle_control.successful_cycle: Add at least two systems that pass the structural promotion gate, or complete and test a named public-data obstruction that changes the next acquisition query.
cycle_control.on_rethink: Do not lower the three-mode gate. Publish the hard-shortfall ledger and decide whether to redesign the observable target, seek proprietary data, or stop the public-data unification claim.
